title: ACCENT: An Automatic Event Commonsense Evaluation Metric for Open-Domain Dialogue Systems
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion. Religious language is used in a few dialogue examples to demonstrate the functionality of the proposed event commonsense extraction method, but the models' performance or understanding of religious concepts is not analyzed.

measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure any aspect of faith or religion. Religious concepts (e.g., 'Christian', 'wiccan', 'pastor') appear incidentally within dialogue examples used to test the paper's primary focus: a general-purpose metric for evaluating 'event commonsense' in open-domain dialogue systems.
